notes.title: v0.10 update
notes.notes:
Note that, unfortunately, this build is not backward-compatible, and will tell you to start a new game.

Changes:


 Better trees
 Ghost plaques on monument
 better alphabet board cables (still not great)
 starting on pro buildings and pro character models
 wilbur and zojiro cutscenes on arrival night
 steam cloud save
 creepy cracks as zapato house puzzle
 various other fixes and improvements
